answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 21 identities per epoch. Audits are logged in oasis, queued in delta, and cipher publishes the wait time. A farm of 163 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3800 identities would post 4689 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
